sentences.text: Vinod Mhatre  had obtained permission to construct a five storey building in the  year 2010.
In the year 2021, Vinod Mhatre submitted a plan to  construct five more floors on the said building through the  applicant, who is an Architect by profession.

A map purported to  have been issued by the Superintendent of Land Records vide M.R.

Based on the documents, including the said map, a revised building permission was granted on 27th July, 2021.

4. Pursuant to a complaint, an inquiry was conducted and it transpired that the map MR No. 215 of 2014 dated 26 th August,
2014 relied upon by the applicant, did not tally with the record maintained in the office of the Deputy Superintendent of Land Records and the said map was not issued by the said office.
Thereupon, an officer of KDMC filed the report.
5. By an order dated 17th November, 2023 this Court had granted interim protection to the applicant.
6. The learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant was not in the frame when the alleged forged map was prepared.
The said map was already part of the record.

sentences.text: the Court was invited to the observations in the order dated 2 nd March, 2024 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, while releasing the employees of KDMC on bail.
7. The learned APP fairly invited attention of the Court to the statement of Maruti Rathod, the then Assistant Director, Town Planning, KDMC.
The said officer has stated before the police that when he had examined the proposal the allegedly forged map was not part of the file.

In view of the aforesaid statement, prima facie,

8. I am, therefore, impelled to make the order of interim bail absolute.
Hence, the following order.
ORDER 1] The order of interim bail dated 17 th November, 2023 is made absolute on the terms and conditions incorporated therein.
2] The applicant shall cooperate with the investigation and attend the investigating officer as and when directed.
